log.msg: DRAG PROVEN at 1280 (ui-test, real pointer): tree before [Notes, Ideas, Archive, probe a, probe b] -> after [Notes, Ideas, Archive, probe b, probe a], and made/page.json on disk read back children [notes, ideas, archive, probe-b, probe-a]. Grabbed probe b's grip at (298,596), dropped on probe a's top edge band. No console errors.

Sortable needed ONE override, no framework change: locate(e). Every row here is itself a container (a page holds pages), so Sortable's innermost-container rule made every point on a row mean 'inside it' and left only the 0.25em (4px at 1280) gap between rows meaning 'before it' - reordering, the thing that replaced the up/down buttons, would have been a 4px target. TreeSort.locate() splits a row into three bands: top 10px = sibling above, middle = child, bottom 10px = sibling below; the indented empty kids box = child. up() finds the parent container through Draggable.registry by walking the DOM, so no wiring is needed at construction.

Bug caught before it shipped: move_to() recomputed the directory name from the title on EVERY drop, so dragging a page whose title had been changed (title 'Reading list', directory 'notes') would silently have moved made/notes/ to made/reading-list/ and 404'd any saved url. It renames only on a real collision now.

Two flex traps found by looking at it: .paging-make-field is a flex COLUMN, so the input's copied flex:1 1 12em was read as a HEIGHT and the Title field came out a 192px grey slab, nothing thrown; and p() does not read markdown, so '**content**' printed literally in two places.

Make.settled() used to redraw the whole screen after EVERY save - invisible when the only control was a chip, and a cursor thrown out of a text field one keystroke later now that the right pane is full of inputs. It redraws only when the store actually changed under it (the dev server went away and the edit fell back to the browser).
Skipped the usage.json refresh: the brief's fence does not include public/framework/ai/usage.json and the mastermind keeps the snapshot current.

CORRECTION: the six log lines above carry 19:36 timestamps typed from my head; the real clock read 19:08 when they were appended. The order is right, the times are ~28 minutes ahead. Everything from this line on is read from the clock immediately before the append.

NESTING PROVEN at 1280: dragged probe a onto the middle of probe b's row. Tree before [notes(today,later,new-tab), ideas(), archive(), probe-b(), probe-a()] -> after [..., probe-b(probe-a)]; on disk made/probe-b/page.json children [probe-a] and made/probe-b/probe-a/page.json title 'probe a'. The mid-drag png (drag-nesting-1280.png) shows the ghost on the cursor and the dashed placeholder in probe b's indented slot.

DELETE PROVEN through the UI: clicked the x on probe b, the row became the question 'Delete probe b and the 1 page under it?', pressed 'Delete it'. Tree -> [notes, ideas, archive], made/page.json children -> [notes, ideas, archive], and both directories gone from disk. All probe-* pages removed; git status public/imagine/paging/made/ is byte-identical to the baseline (3 modified, 2 untracked, the owner's own).

A defect the first delete run found: the x button did nothing and threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading empty)'. .append(fn) runs fn SYNCHRONOUSLY inside the expression whose result is being assigned to $row, so the closure's $row was still undefined when acts() was built. The view is handed to the callback as its first argument - .append($r => ...) - which is exactly what the old capture form div.c(cls, $row => ...) had been giving it. Fixed and re-proven.

Another one the same run: my centre stage's draw seam returned early when a page had no blocks, and draw REPLACES the stage's own call to sample() - so the content word drew nothing at all on every blockless page and no control said so. It is stage.sample(!!draw_blocks(...)) now, which is what BuildStage always did.

3440 SPACING, measured at the three widths. 1280: panes 957 = tree 230 + page 410 + settings 287, gap 15.0px. 1920: 1546 = 371 + 674 + 464, gap 18.4px. 3440: 2847 = 416 (26rem cap) + 1877 + 480 (30rem cap), gap 37.3px, pane padding 22.4px. No horizontal overflow at any width (scrollWidth == clientWidth). Widest paragraph 720px at 3440, down from 1830 before the note was capped at --measure. The OLD screen at 3440 was a 3027px prose column with a 648px lede, --flow 54px and an h3 margin-top of 104px.

OWNER FEEDBACK, all four folded in. (1) A page you made keeps core's own h1 - heading: true on the pages grow() builds, because Paging.render() strips the h1 from every page in this realm and a page you made is not a demo; the centre's header is a real h1.page-title, which needed .paging-make-head h1.paging-make-head-title to match core's own (0,2,1) or it rendered at clamp(1.75rem, 9vw, 3em). (2) Each pane paints its own surface, border and radius - the screen is three boxes. (3) A child column opened inside a stage splits the room: .paging-pane was flex: 0 0 clamp(10em, 38%, 22em), a hard 352px, and is flex: 1 1 0 with a floor; .page-frame-mid:has(> .paging-pane) > .paging-canvas takes a zero basis too, scoped to the one arrangement where the box has a sibling. Measured 485/485 in a 979px stage at 1920. (4) Self-evident: the tree pane has a heading and one line saying what a drag does, every row control carries a title, the name button carries aria-pressed and a title naming the consequence, and the selected row wears a coloured border and wash.

OUT OF FENCE, done deliberately and reported: paging.css beyond the .paging-make-* block (the .paging-pane split, item 3 of the owner's feedback - the cause was a track rule in paging.css, not in stage.js), and paging/readme.md (five sentences that claimed two editors). Both diffs are small and commented in place.

LEFT OPEN, with reasons. (a) Keyboard drag-and-drop: the brief said it was not required this pass; a row is reachable and operable by keyboard for select/star/add/delete, but reordering needs the pointer. The shape it wants is arrow-key move on a focused grip writing through the same Make.move_to(). (b) Blocks are not draggable - they keep up/down arrows; a block list is two or three items in a 26rem column, where a grip and a drop target are more machinery than the thing they move. (c) rail.js still reads '1 Make a page' / '2 Build it out' under 'EDITORS (THESE SAVE)'; out of fence, and the one-line diff is: title '2 Build it out' -> 'Build (now in Make)', section title 'Editors (these save)' -> 'The editor (it saves)'. (d) doc/decisions.md line 882 says 'The controls are make/tabs.js' in the present tense; that file was renamed to make/tree.js. Out of fence, one word.

Deleted, not moved: build/stage.js (98 lines - ../stage.js's PagingStage draws the page now), make/tabs.js (186), ~190 lines of card/control/file-pane layout out of build/build.css, 76 lines of .paging-make-* out of paging.css, and build/page.js went 540 -> 47. Net across the realm: 515 insertions, 1521 deletions.
